text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide wins the senior division URA award. During her interview, she's asked about her leg injury and her sister's absence, but her answers are vague.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide challenges Narita Brian to a scrimmage. However, there's a sense of awkwardness to the moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian tells her that if they're going to face each other, she wants it to be in a G1 race and declines the invitation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she has no way of knowing why Biwa Hayahide challenged her…
